title: 10. Exercises: Day 10 — Pydantic AI Fundamentals (Projects): Build 2 Productivity Agents

objectives: Solve the Day 10 — Pydantic AI Fundamentals (Projects): Build 2 Productivity Agents exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
1. **Add a `category` field to `ActionItem` (e.g., `engineering`, `ops`, `communication`)** and a second validator that rejects any item whose category is not in the allowed enum.
   <details><summary>Hint</summary>Add `category: Literal["engineering", "ops", "communication"]` to the model — Literal enforces this at parse time, so the validator is redundant. For cross-field rules like "if priority is high, category must be engineering", add it in the `@result_validator`.</details>

2. **Replace the hardcoded handbook with a tool** that fetches a paragraph by index. The agent decides which paragraphs to fetch before answering.
   <details><summary>Hint</summary>Define `@doc_agent.tool def get_paragraph(ctx, index: int) -> str: return HANDBOOK_PARAGRAPHS[index-1]`. Remove the system-prompt injection. Citations then map to the indices the agent fetched.</details>

3. **Combine the two agents**: run the Action Item Extractor on the transcript from Day 8's Meeting Note Summarizer. Compare outputs.
   <details><summary>Hint</summary>Copy the transcript constant from `meeting_summarizer.py` into a shared module, import it in both, run both agents, and print each one's items.</details>
